title: Fix correct answer option text color and bold styling in quiz screen

requirements.text: In QuizScreen.tsx, fix the correct answer option so that after the user clicks and the answer is revealed, the text label of the correct option is displayed in a clearly visible, high-contrast font color (e.g., dark text such as deep teal or dark green, not white-on-white or invisible) and is rendered in bold. The image shows that option B is highlighted with a teal/green background and border but the option text is invisible — this must be corrected so the text is legible against the highlighted background. Apply the same fix to ReviewScreen.tsx wherever the correct answer option is highlighted.

quotes: On the correct option the font colour not seen after click so change the font colour and bold the correct option

acceptanceCriteria: After clicking an option in the quiz, the correct answer option displays its text in a clearly visible, high-contrast color against the highlighted background (teal/green).
The correct answer option text is rendered in bold (font-weight: bold or font-bold Tailwind class).
The fix is applied in both QuizScreen.tsx and ReviewScreen.tsx for all correct-answer highlighted states.
Incorrect options and unselected options retain their existing text color and weight.
No other UI element styling is changed.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Only change text color and font-weight styling for the correct answer highlighted state — do not alter background colors, border colors, or layout.
nonGoals: Changing the background or border color of the correct answer highlight.
Modifying the quiz logic or answer selection behavior.
Changing styling of incorrect or unselected options.
